caption:

Nobody makes that sound alone.

That's not slacking. That's you doing exactly what the program appeared to ask for. But you picked a weight you knew you'd land on, and now the number tells neither of us anything.

title: My kids weren’t happier in a five-star resort than they were in a tiny tent.
hook: My kids weren’t happier in a five-star resort than they were in a tiny tent.
caption:
My kids weren’t happier in a five-star resort than they were in a tiny tent.

But I was — because this time, I got to choose.

For years I took the cheapest holiday I could find.

Not because I wanted to. Because there was nothing else in the account.

I think that’s what most coaches are really working for.

Not the €10K itself — the freedom to say yes without checking whether it was a good month.

That only comes when you stop leaving your next clients to chance.

We’re running a workshop on how to get your next five clients, consistently. Comment WORKSHOP and I’ll send you the link.
